# Chainscaner

> Chainscaner is a multi-chain wallet compliance checker modeled on
> Chainalysis-grade flagging (Reactor / KYT-style). It screens wallet
> addresses across 12 EVM networks, maps token exposure, traces cross-chain
> and bridge activity beyond direct counterparties, correlates proximity to
> sanctioned, mixer and darknet clusters, and compiles a compliance-grade
> risk report with a wallet-confirmed attestation queue for flagged assets.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chainscaner.com/): Product overview — what the engine
  screens, how flags and risk tiers work
- [Flag Checker](https://chainscaner.com/checker): Run a wallet scan —
  exposure mapping, proximity correlation, risk scoring, attestation plan
- [Wallet Send](https://chainscaner.com/wallet): Token send/confirm view
  used by the attestation flow

## How the engine works

1. Multi-chain exposure scan — native balance, full ERC-20 coverage and
   live gas price across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism,
   Base, Avalanche, Celo, Fantom, Cronos, Linea and Scroll
2. Cross-hop tracing — exposure beyond direct counterparties, including
   bridge-routed value that crossed chains before settling
3. Proximity scoring — sanctions, mixer and darknet cluster correlation;
   severity tiers: Low (<25), Moderate (25–49), High (50–74), Critical (≥75)
4. Attestation queue — flagged assets cleared through sequential,
   wallet-confirmed on-chain transfers with per-chain gas budgeting
5. Compliance-grade report — flags, affected chains, hygiene findings
   (dust/unprocessable exposure), and transaction hashes

## Technical notes

- Balance screening is read-only: standard JSON-RPC (`eth_call`,
  `eth_getBalance`, `eth_gasPrice`) — no signing required to scan
- Transfers always require explicit wallet confirmation; nothing signs
  silently
- USD valuation via public price feeds with local fallbacks; fail-open dust
  classification below $1
- This site is a controlled security-analysis demonstration environment
